roles.mechanical: all syllables, source-derived arbitrary chains, recovery contracts only; no phrase correctness labels
roles.source-retrieval: 5000 hash-selected stored phrases >=3 glyphs; seen-source retrieval, not generalization
roles.glyph-audit: all prior 499 inputs; MOE/UD used only after decoding
roles.essay-regression: previously evaluated Taiwan.md prose, not fresh holdout
roles.encyclopedic-regression: previously evaluated Chinese GSD and other frozen rows, not natural conversation
roles.authored-conversation-regression: previously inspected author-written conversation scenarios; not population accuracy
